entities.summary: Trishneet Arora is an Indian ethical hacker, and entrepreneur. He is the founder and CEO of TAC Security, a cyber security company. He was named in Forbes 30 Under 30 2018 Asia list and Fortune India 40 Under 40 2019 list of India's Brightest Business Minds.
